# Rules (canonical)

**Language:** All rule bodies and frontmatter in `rules/cursor/` are **English**. Localized human guides live under `docs/` or `skills/*/README.md` — not inside `.mdc` files.

**Source of truth:** `cursor/*.mdc` only.

**Generated output:** `kiro/<stem>.md` is produced from `cursor/<stem>.mdc` (1:1 names) by `scripts/sync-ide-rules.sh` (`make sync-ide`). **Do not edit generated steering files by hand** — changes are overwritten on the next sync. Index: [cursor/README.md](./cursor/README.md), [kiro/README.md](./kiro/README.md).

## Frontmatter convention (Cursor)

Every `rules/cursor/*.mdc` file starts with YAML frontmatter:

| Field | Required | Values |
| ----- | -------- | ------ |
| `description` | yes | One line (or folded `>`) — **English**; shown in Cursor rule picker |
| `alwaysApply` | yes | `true` = every session; `false` = file-scoped or on demand |
| `globs` | when `alwaysApply: false` and file-scoped | Comma-separated patterns, e.g. `"**/*.ts"` or `"**/*.tsx, **/*.jsx"` |

Do **not** use non-standard keys (`glob`, `priority`, …). Do not set `globs` when `alwaysApply: true`.

| Intent | Cursor frontmatter | Kiro `inclusion` |
| ------ | ------------------ | ---------------- |
| Always on | `alwaysApply: true` | `always` |
| By file type | `alwaysApply: false` + `globs: "..."` | `fileMatch` + `fileMatchPattern` |
| On demand (skills/workflows) | `alwaysApply: false` (no `globs`) | `manual` |

Details: [CONVENTIONS.md](./CONVENTIONS.md).

## Sync

| From | To |
| ---- | -- |
| `rules/cursor/<stem>.mdc` | `rules/kiro/<stem>.md` (generated in repo, same stem) |
| `rules/cursor/` | `~/.cursor/rules/` (symlink → whole folder) |
| `rules/kiro/` | `~/.kiro/steering/` (symlink → whole folder) |
| `skills/` | `~/.cursor/skills/`, `~/.kiro/skills/` (symlink → whole folder) |

Repo `Workspace/.cursor/` and `Workspace/.kiro/` are **not** used by sync (gitignored).

From the Workspace root:

```bash
./scripts/sync-ide.sh    # or: make sync-ide
```

Example output:

```text
  rules/cursor/dotnet.mdc → rules/kiro/dotnet.md
  ...
Generated Kiro rules in .../rules/kiro
  ~/.cursor/rules → .../rules/cursor/ (N .mdc)
  ~/.kiro/steering → .../rules/kiro/ (N steering files)
  ~/.cursor/skills → .../skills/
  ~/.kiro/skills → .../skills/
```

## `cursor/` files

| File | `alwaysApply` | `globs` | Contents |
| ---- | ------------- | ------- | -------- |
| `code-standards.mdc` | `true` | — | Shared defaults (all files) |
| `question-scope.mdc` | `true` | — | Question Scope triggers → skill **`question-scope`** |
| `typescript.mdc` | `false` | `**/*.ts` | Backend / shared TS |
| `react.mdc` | `false` | `**/*.tsx`, `**/*.jsx` | React UI |
| `python.mdc` | `false` | `**/*.py` | Python services/workers |
| `dotnet.mdc` | `false` | `**/*.cs` | .NET / C# |
| `java.mdc` | `false` | `**/*.java` | Java backend |
| `workflow.mdc` | `false` | — | Workflow rule IDs & handoffs (on demand; Kiro: load `workflow.md` steering) |

## Layout

```text
rules/
  cursor/*.mdc          ← edit (canonical)
  kiro/<stem>.md        ← generated by sync-ide-rules.sh (1:1 with cursor)
  README.md
  CONVENTIONS.md
  QUICKSTART.md
  RECOVERY.md          ← post-restore notes (optional read)

~/.cursor/rules/                → symlink → rules/cursor/
~/.kiro/steering/               → symlink → rules/kiro/
~/.cursor/skills/               → symlink → skills/
~/.kiro/skills/                 → symlink → skills/
```

| Directory | IDE | Format |
| --------- | --- | ------ |
| `cursor/` | Cursor (`~/.cursor/rules/`) | `*.mdc` — **edit here** |
| `kiro/` | Kiro (`~/.kiro/steering/`) | `<stem>.md` — **generated** (same stem as cursor) |
